notes.title: NoReload Heroes 1.1 patch notes
notes.content:
- Improved encounter scaling for 1 & 2 player parties
- Early floors are now somewhat shorter (fewer rooms until teleporter)
	- This is meant to speed up the early game for more experienced players
	- Total amount of loot & experience is still the same
- Refino-bot boss has to cool down a bit more between attacks
- Dead enemies drop their loot a bit faster
- Fixed some issues in online play
	- Fixed a bug that prevented starting a party game from the online lobby

Happy gaming!
